summary: From the command, the save reproduces the full path (editor-service.save -> text-file-service.save -> text-file-models.save -> participants -> write), leaves the model clean with saved==version and changes the disk. Through Ctrl+S, the keybinding resolves, but the command service passes args [] and file-commands save requires input.resource instead of resolving the active editor (fileCommands.ts:417-436), so the run aborts.

Format on save formats through the TS formatter on eh1 before the write, and the formatted text is written. Correction: files.participants.timeout bounds only create/rename/delete file operation participants (workingCopyFileOperationParticipant.ts:32); save participants have no timeout, only a Skip progress after 5 s.

Correction: only the ext host onWillSave participant is bounded (1750 ms, mainThreadSaveParticipant.ts:35-38); its error is logged and the save proceeds. A slow formatter has no timeout; the user's Skip cancels it and the save proceeds unformatted. The model gets the outcome right, but the 1750 ms budget is not modeled (the ext-host stub has no timeout_ms, so the save waits 30 s), Skip is not modeled, and 4 of the 6 save participants are missing from the chain.

State-driven conflict (newer mtime on disk): the write fails file-modified-since from the model's dirty-write check, Compare/Overwrite is offered, and Overwrite re-saves with ignore_modified_since (etag '') and succeeds. Correction: Overwrite uses ignoreModifiedSince with reason EXPLICIT, not force (textFileSaveErrorHandler.ts:381-394).

A single edit auto-saves with reason auto 1000 ms later (passes), and the superseded-schedule logic is modeled. The debounce across two keystrokes can't be driven: scenario steps drain their timers before the next step, so the second edit cannot land while the first timer is pending.

The afterDelay auto save reaches the format participant with reason auto, which returns without formatting; an explicit save in the same world formats. Correction: only SaveReason.AUTO skips formatting (saveParticipants.ts:230-232); focus-change and window-change auto saves do format.

Type then undo restores the text and alternative version, and the file model turns clean (passes). But saved_version_id stores the file model's version_id, not the text model's alternative version id (textFileEditorModel.ts:1100-1108), so type/undo/save/type/undo stays dirty where the code is clean. text-model.undo also bypasses the undo-redo service (a no-op hop), and the cursor is not restored.

Files side correct: the revert reads from disk, the model is clean, nothing is written. But the editor's text-model keeps the dirty text, because the model holds two buffers and file-side reloads never update the editor's copy; in the code they are one TextModel.

The listener reloads the clean model with the new disk content and shows no prompt, but the editor's text-model keeps the old text (two buffers). There is also no watcher -> file service -> manager event chain: the flow enters at text-file-models.on-did-files-change.
